title: Something changes on screen every few seconds — holds are declared, never accidental
principle: Top-performing edits keep a constant visual pulse: short-form retention data shows cuts every 2-4s; long-form educational pacing alternates fast micro-cut stretches with deliberate processing holds. Dead frames shed viewers; undeclared stillness is an editing defect, not a style.
rule: No stretch longer than ~5s without a visual event (cut, set-piece motion, reveal); intentional holds are declared in the plan (solver holdMs) and capped at ~15s. Enforced by lib/quality-bar.mjs validateCadence at the ship gate.

source.name: Miracamp — Editing a YouTube video: duration and speed tips (alternating micro-cuts with holds); OpusClip — Ideal YouTube Shorts length & format for retention (2-4s cuts); Sound Images — Mastering video length & pacing
